definitions.explanation: The quality of being useful for actual, everyday purposes rather than for theory or decoration.

examples.japanese: {実用|じつよう}{的|てき}なデザインが{好|す}きだ。
この{技術|ぎじゅつ}はまだ{実用|じつよう}{化|か}されていない。
examples.english: This technology hasn't been put to practical use yet.

examples.japanese: {実用|じつよう}{英語|えいご}を{学|まな}びたい。
examples.english: I want to learn practical English.

notes:
COMMON COMPOUNDS:
・{実用|じつよう}{的|てき} (practical)
・{実用|じつよう}{化|か} (commercialization, practical application)
・{実用|じつよう}{性|せい} (practicality)
・{実用|じつよう}{新案|しんあん} (utility model patent)

COMMON USES:
・{実用|じつよう}{英語|えいご} (practical English)
・{実用|じつよう}{書|しょ} (practical how-to books)
・{実用|じつよう}{品|ひん} (practical items)

OPPOSITE:
・{理論|りろん}{的|てき} (theoretical)
・{装飾|そうしょく}{的|てき} (decorative)

[Register: Neutral to Formal]
